title: System prompt
description: Give the requests agents send a system prompt of yours, in each API's own place for one: Anthropic's system, the first system or developer message of Chat, Responses' instructions, Gemini's systemInstruction. Nothing is added while the prompt is empty.
prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.hint: A request without a system prompt gets this one.
override.label: Add it to prompts agents already have
override.hint: Off: a request that has its own system prompt keeps it unchanged. Codex sends its own model instructions, and changing them can change how its models behave: leave Codex out with the agent filter.
position.label: Where it goes
position.hint: Only when adding to an existing prompt.
filters.title: Only for some requests
filters.description: Leave both empty to apply to every request.
agents.label: Agents
agents.hint: Astra client ids, such as claude-code or codex. Only these agents get the prompt.
models.label: Models
models.hint: Model name prefixes, such as claude or deepseek. Only these models get the prompt.
